name: Growing In Knowledge
overview: Scripture reveals that true knowledge begins with the fear of the LORD, recognizing Him as the foundation of wisdom and instruction (Proverbs 1:7). Growing in knowledge involves a continual renewal of the mind, enabling believers to discern God’s perfect will (Romans 12:2) and to be filled with spiritual wisdom and understanding (Colossians 1:9). This growth is marked by speaking truth in love, maturing in Christ as the head (Ephesians 4:15), and increasing in love combined with sound judgment (Philippians 1:9). However, spiritual dullness hinders this growth, emphasizing the need for attentive hearing and responsiveness to God’s word (Hebrews 5:11).
